product_summary: Reservoil (Vashi, Navi Mumbai) is a technical sales/marketing and consultancy house for upstream oil & gas equipment, not an IT/electronics company. Two product lines per its own site: (1) Instruments — core analysis equipment sold under its own 'Make - RESERVOIL' brand (core plugging machine, automated plug trimmer, trimming/grinding machine, automated slabbing saw, wax bath, Dean-Stark units, Soxhlet extractors, vapour extractor, oven, helium porosimeter, steady-state permeameter, digital core/mineral fluorescence imaging, sample saturator, relative-permeability and electrical-properties systems, ageing/flooding setups, plastic core boxes, heat-shrink tubes); subsurface data-acquisition instruments under 'Make - SPARTEK' (quartz/sapphire pressure gauges, side-pocket mandrel gauge, wellhead data recorder, data-acquisition loggers, production logging systems, permanent monitoring, multi-cycle shut-in tool, HEAT tool); cementing equipment under 'Make - GRACE INSTRUMENT' (variable-speed mixer, consistometers, HP/HT UCA, fluid-loss tester, rheometer, curing chamber, corrosion tester). (2) Software — KAPPA (Saphir NL, Topaze NL, Rubis, Emeraude, Citrine), Petrosys, Pegasus Vertex, LMKR, EasyCopy/EasyCore, plus consultancy. The company itself publishes HS codes only for the core-analysis instruments (8459 2910, 8464 1010, 8419 8990, 7017 9090, 8514 1000, 9027 9090, 3926 9099); no HS code is published for the gauges, PLS, cementing equipment or software.
comment: Declared 903180 ('measuring/checking instruments, other') is only partially corroborated. The company's own catalogue does contain measuring instruments that plausibly fall in 9031/9027 (porosimeter, permeameter, electrical-properties and relative-permeability systems, pressure gauges), and it self-declares 9027 9090 for the porosimeter — so 903180 is not absurd, but it is a single generic line covering a catalogue that is mostly machinery (8459/8464), laboratory ovens and extraction glassware (8419/7017), and software. Industry classification 'IT и электроника' is a misclassification: the site describes itself as 'Leading Technical Sales & Marketing of O&G industry equipments' with 'Expert Consultancy in Petroleum Engineering domain & Advanced Software Solutions' — i.e. oilfield equipment + petroleum-engineering software, not IT/electronics. Trader signs are explicit: the Principals page lists 12+ foreign manufacturers (DCI Corporation, Spartek Systems, Kappa Engineering, Petrosys, Grace Instrument, PMAC Group, OFITE, ZF China Geophysical, Wildcat Technologies, Pegasus Vertex, LMKR, EasyCopy) that it represents 'as the marketing partner in India'; only the core-analysis line is badged 'Make - RESERVOIL'. Product lines missing from the declaration: core plugging/trimming/slabbing machinery (8459/8464), laboratory ovens and extraction apparatus (8419/7017), heat-shrink tubes and plastic core boxes (3926), cement-testing and rheology instruments, production-logging and permanent-monitoring systems, and the entire software/consultancy line (which is a service, not a good, and should not be declared under any HS code). Per Rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground — company is retained and the code should be corrected/expanded to the actual mix. All product statements above are from the company's own website (reservoil.com/products, /instruments, /principals) and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line was checked in this task (out of scope), so no shipment-level corroboration exists for any code. Note also that the site is a 2020-vintage brochure site with no e-commerce or catalogue pricing; the legal-entity name 'Reservoil LLP' and the claimed contact person 'MADHU RAKESH SHARMA' could not be corroborated from the website (no names, CIN, PAN or LLPIN published on the pages read) — null, not public on the site.
